The issuer shows massive scale with over $9.2 billion in revenue, but suffers from extremely weak profitability, razor-thin margins (7% gross, 0% operating), and a net loss of $139 million. While the company maintains a marginally acceptable short-term liquidity position (current ratio of 1.21) and a positive equity cushion ($2.52 billion), the high leverage (total liabilities of $7.476 billion against assets of $10.039 billion) combined with negative net earnings indicates substantial credit risk. These financial metrics align with a highly speculative, non-investment grade profile where debt service capacity is weak and vulnerable to ongoing operating losses.

DECISION: B-
